description: Find fractional basket currencies that can convert between specified currencies. Returns all baskets that hold the listed currencies as reserves, along with their current state (reserves, prices, conversion volumes). Use this to discover conversion paths before calling estimateconversion or sendcurrency with convertto. Two input modes: simple (pass currency names) or advanced (pass a query object with target conversion details).

currencies.description: Simple mode: array of currency names. Returns all baskets containing all listed currencies as reserves.

params.description: Advanced mode: query object with convertto, fromcurrency, targetprice, amount, slippage fields. See tool spec for details.

name: getcurrencyconverters
